test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

He asked us, “When are you reaching?”

options.text: He asked us whether we are reaching.
He asked us when we will reach.
He asked us when we were reaching.
He asked us when will you reach?

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. He asked us when we were reaching.**
